challenge.fairSummary: First summarize the idea fairly, then write your critique.
challenge.feedbackTooShort: Your restatement is too short to show you engaged with the argument. Restate the other side's point in a sentence or two before disagreeing.
challenge.feedbackNotEngaged: That doesn't look like an engagement with the argument -- try restating the point you're responding to.
challenge.feedbackAbusive: Personal attacks aren't allowed here. Disagree with the argument, not the person, and try again.
challenge.feedbackNotConnected: This doesn't appear connected to the argument you're challenging. Restate the point you're responding to first -- even approaching it from a different angle is fine, as long as the relationship is clear.
challenge.feedbackNeedsClarity: Your point may be relevant, but the connection to the original argument isn't clear yet. Try explaining which part of the argument you're responding to and why their reasoning falls short.

existence.title: What is ThoughtDom?
existence.intro: The name ThoughtDom comes from Thought + Freedom (Domain of Freedom). It is a platform built on one simple rule:
paragraphs: Most platforms tie your identity to your ideas. They write your name next to your thoughts and make them part of your permanent record. This turns conversation into performance, and dialogue into judgment and punishment.

anonymity.title: Built-in Anonymity & Privacy
anonymity.intro: On ThoughtDom, your ideas are independent of who you are.
items: You can participate without revealing your identity. We don't link your real-world identity to your posts.
Your personal reputation stays yours, and your ideas live freely.
An argument must be judged on its own merit, not on who said it.
anonymity.closing: This changes everything fundamentally. When no one knows who you are, you can think calmly and clearly. You can change your mind and try out ideas that don't fit your public image.

principles.description: A better question is worth more than a final answer. A belief that hasn't been thought through is fragile.
You don't have to agree with someone to learn from them. Understanding the opposing view is the beginning of dialogue, not the end of it.
Your ideas matter; your behavioral data does not. We don't build profiles on anyone or surveil anyone.
The goal is mutual understanding, not winning an argument, scoring political points, or accumulating followers.

steelManGate.title: The Steel-Man Gate
steelManGate.intro: Before you criticize an idea, you must first state it so clearly and fairly for its owner that they would say:
steelManGate.quote: "Yes, that is exactly what I mean."
steelManGate.body: Only then do you have the right to disagree.
paragraphs: This friction is intentional. It slows you down and forces you past your first impulses — like quick rejection, anger, or a rush to win. It asks you to truly listen.
Genuine understanding is built this way.

neverBecome.title: What ThoughtDom Will Never Be

items.title: A Surveillance or Ad Engine
items.description: We don't build hidden behavioral profiles or collect your data to sell.

items.title: An Addiction Machine
items.description: We are not designed to capture your attention indefinitely. When you're done, you can leave the platform.

items.title: A Popularity Contest
items.description: Follower counts don't make ideas powerful, and they don't make them worthless either.

neverBecome.intro: ThoughtDom will never track you, sell your data, or optimize you into an engagement metric. It is a place for thoughts, not a funnel.

vision.title: The Ultimate Goal
vision.intro: Our metric for success is not user growth or time spent on the platform.
vision.question: Our question is very simple:
vision.closing: Did a conversation help two people understand each other a little better?
paragraphs: The internet is full of places to be heard and monitored. We built a place for free thinking and mutual understanding.

intro.title: Who we are
paragraphs: ThoughtDom is developed and maintained by NovaTech — a small group of builders who believe ideas deserve a place where they are judged on their own merit.
We don't collect emails, phone numbers, or behavioral data. There are no follower counts to chase and no profiles to perform for. Just a quiet space for ideas and honest conversation.
If you ever want to reach us, we're around on Instagram and Telegram.

about.closing: A place for ideas, not identities.
